svg.text: BRIDGE-MW-001 · Media Wall — reference configuration MW-L1 (3.60 × 2.70 m, 75″ screen, next-size-up bay)
Front elevation · section A–A through the screen bay · five layout variants. Numbers → legend. Dimensions in mm, heights above FFL.
ceiling 2700
FFL ±0
2000 — screen bay (fits 85″)
bench 550
screen 838–1773
crown 2450
A–A section through the screen bay
AVR
200 recess
450 AV bay
Layout variants (same modules, different arrangement)
MW-L1 · Classic, symmetric
niche · screen · niche — the reference
MW-L2 · Fire to the side
screen and fire never share a column
MW-L3 · Fire below the screen
deflector + clearance rule (§4.5)
MW-L4 · Cinema front stage
L C R behind acoustic fabric
MW-L5 · Rail kit (no chasing)
rental / retrofit, panels on a rail
Legend
Bracket no-drill zone — solid 18 mm ply backing, no cable or box inside it
Box A behind the screen: socket · Cat6A · HDMI (beside the bracket, hidden by the screen)
Box B at the AV bay — the user end of the media-wall route
User route A ↔ B, M63 (sized for an HDMI plug), open ends, nothing permanent
User port panel: USB-C · HDMI in · USB data · optical
Full-width intake slot (low) — exhaust slot under the bench top (high)
Service column: magnetic access panel — drivers, isolator, IR hub, junctions
Presence sensor in the shadow gap
IR window for remotes (to the IR hub behind 7)
Notification light NTL (BRIDGE) — four RGBW pixels
Bias light, 6500 K — behind the screen, ~10 % of the picture brightness
Cove uplight (AMBIENT), 2700–3000 K, ≥ 150 mm below the ceiling
Niche accent (ACCENT), 3000 K narrow beam, source above the sight line
Acoustic slat panel — first-reflection absorber
Plinth / toe-kick light (EGRESS), 2200 K — assured bus B in BRIDGE
Subwoofer bay with grille, floor-coupled
Soundbar socket at the end of the slot — no extension leads
Open-fronted sound slot (soundbar never in a closed box)
18 mm ply backing over the full recess back — the bracket can move
Frame cavity: route A ↔ B and the AV feeds, MAINS kept to one side
AV bay airflow: front-low in, rear plenum, out high
Existing wall — the build-out stands free of it (decoupled, K33)
